repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies valve closing once before entering the cycle, but the candidate closes the valve on every cycle iteration (in the else branch). At 60000ms, IR emitted only email, but JoI emitted both valve close and email. The valve action must be outside the periodic cycle body.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed valve close from the else branch and moved it to execute once before the cycle. The cycle body now contains only the email action as specified by the IR.
